question.problem:
What model could represent the division problem below?

$$
3 \div \dfrac{1}{6} = 18
$$
question.worked_solution:
Consider the following $\color{red}3$ wholes:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129499/assets/235e19c4e3231eb22e6d43ccadcd90c5694077ec4ce562e6c4f188cfff77545f.png)

To calculate ${\color{red}3} \div \dfrac{1}{\color{blue}6}$, we need to divide each of $\color{red}3$ wholes into $\color{blue}6$ equal parts, as shown below. This gives us the corresponding model for the given division problem.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129499/assets/3b3551ad59a9d5abe2bf03e350f373412959293c68a4f059123fafcbabf72936.png)

We get ${\color{red}3} \times {\color{blue}6}= 18$ pieces in total.
